source: Not a book section. The seams follow CodeHS AP CSA (Cortado) Unit 3 lessons 3.8 Scope and Access and 3.9 Class Variables, and reuse the object model the course already teaches in 5.3/5.4. Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Where a variable lives
lessons.objective: Students will be able to say which of a method's variables is a local, which is a property, and which survives until the next frame.

lessons.title: Who owns the rule
lessons.objective: Students will be able to move a rule out of the scene and into the class that owns the data, and say what a method buys them that a direct property write does not.

lessons.title: Objects that meet
lessons.objective: Students will be able to write a method whose parameter is another instance, and keep a collection of instances clean as they die.

lessons.title: One value for the whole class
lessons.objective: Students will be able to declare a class variable with `static`, count every instance ever built, and say why one counter cannot belong to one enemy.

lessons.title: The wave spawner
lessons.objective: Students will be able to assemble a class, an array and a timer into a spawner that creates and removes instances while the sketch runs, and say where each piece of its state lives.

lessons.title: Unit 5 check
lessons.objective: Students will be able to answer, from across 5.3 to 5.5, what a class is, what a constructor does, what this means, where a variable lives and what a class variable is.
